remarks: *****OPEN HOUSE HAS BEEN CANCELLED*****Experience resort-style living at "The Park", an exceptional gated estate on 3 private acres in the heart of Westport. This meticulously renovated home offers 8 bedrooms-including a private 2-bedroom apartment w/ full kitchen and living space-perfect for guests, staff or extended family. At the heart of the home is a sun-drenched designer chef's kitchen w/island, gorgeous built-ins, large dining area, & folding glass doors that seamlessly bring the outdoors in. Upstairs find a luxurious Primary Suite w/2 custom walk-in closets, a spa-like bath & private balcony overlooking breathtaking serene grounds, 4 add'l guestrooms, a spacious playroom or office w/ balcony & large laundry room. Every inch of this home is crafted for comfort & elegance, blending modern luxury w/ timeless sophistication. Ideally located just minutes from top schools, beaches, shops, restaurants, train station, country clubs, hiking trails, & only 20 minutes to an airport. Also available for SUMMER RENTAL at $50k/month
